metadata.title: Soulwayo — Healing, Embodiment & Remembrance
metadata.description: Soulwayo is a space for healing, embodiment and remembrance — trauma therapy, somatic healing, ceremony and retreats with Sarah & Johannes.

hero.tagline: A sacred space for people who are ready to remember who they truly are.
hero.subLine1: A journey back into connection — with your body, your heart, and your soul.
hero.subLine2: Through trauma healing, somatic work, conscious rituals, and transformative community.

space.eyebrow: For when the mind cannot carry it further
space.headline: Many people today feel exhausted, overwhelmed, disconnected, and lost. You are not searching for another technique. You are searching for something real:
space.want1: I want to feel myself again.
space.want2: I want to release old patterns.
space.want3: I want to feel safe in my body.
space.bodyPre: Soulwayo is the space that meets you there — where the nervous system can soften, emotions can move, and life can begin to flow again. We do not work
space.bodyPost: you — in presence, safety and truth.

pillars.intro: Where psychology, body wisdom, and consciousness come together — Soulwayo integrates trauma healing, somatic approaches, and ancient wisdom traditions into one path.

p1.title: Trauma Therapy & Somatic Healing
p1.before: I am functioning, but I feel disconnected from myself.
p1.after: I feel safe in my body again and reconnect with my inner strength and authenticity.
p1.body: Emotional processing, nervous system regulation and trauma integration — through psychotherapy and body-based work. A slow return to inner stability and self-trust.

p2.title: Ceremony, Fire & Cacao
p2.before: I feel stuck in my head and disconnected from my heart.
p2.after: I reconnect with my inner peace, clarity, and life energy.
p2.body: Meditation, Grandfather Fire and sacred cacao. Space beyond the thinking mind — for heart opening, emotional release and reconnection to intuition and truth.

p3.title: Retreats
p3.before: I feel exhausted, disconnected, and unsure of my path.
p3.after: I return home to myself, gain clarity, and experience deep connection.
p3.body: Immersive healing journeys in nature — silence, ceremony and guided inner work. Here, healing is not rushed; it unfolds in its own intelligent rhythm.

p4.title: Soulwayo Tribe
p4.intro: You do not have to walk your healing journey alone.
p4.body: Monthly ceremonies, online meditations, community circles, and sharing spaces. Not only events — a home.

about.heading: The Journey That Brought Us Here
about.p1: Soulwayo was not created from a place of perfection. It was created from life itself — from moments of deep transformation, challenges, healing, and the courage to keep listening to the voice within.
about.p2: We both walked our own paths of awakening, learning that true healing does not come from avoiding pain, but from meeting ourselves with compassion, awareness, and love. The moments that challenged us the most carried the greatest invitations for growth. Life taught us that the body remembers, the heart knows, and that healing happens when we create a safe space where all parts of ourselves are allowed to be seen.
about.sarahRest: has been shaped by years of supporting others through psychotherapy, trauma healing, embodiment, kids yoga, meditation, and spiritual practices. Her own experiences through motherhood, life challenges, and healing journeys have shown her the importance of compassion, presence, and reconnecting with the wisdom of the body.
about.johannesRest: brings a deep understanding of transformation, consciousness, and the connection between mind, body, and soul. Through his own inner journey, he learned the power of presence, authenticity, and holding space for others as they return to themselves.
about.p5: Together, we created Soulwayo because we believe humanity is entering a time where we are being called back into connection — with ourselves, with each other, and with the natural world. Our vision extends to the next generation — through conscious parenting, family healing, and supporting children emotionally. We believe healing does not begin with adults alone.
about.p6Italic: walking the path of the soul
about.p6Post: A space where ancient wisdom and modern healing meet, where psychology, body and spirituality come together, and where people are invited to remember their own inner wholeness.
about.quote: We do not guide people from a place of having all the answers. We walk beside them as fellow humans, holding a loving and safe space where transformation can unfold.

retreats.headline: A space to return to yourself.
retreats.quote: A call to slow down. To feel again. To breathe again.
retreats.body: Held by nature, presence and deep emotional safety. You are not asked to perform, fix or achieve. You are invited to arrive — exactly as you are.
retreats.highlight1: 3 Days & Nights of Workshops and Rituals

flyer.title: Awaken Your True Path
flyer.body: A journey of initiation, alignment and inner leadership. Shed old skins. Choose your soul path anew. Walk beside us in presence and reverence.
flyer.festivalLine3: Small workshops, painting, music, nature, shared food & drinks and so much more.

final.vision: We remind people that healing is possible. That every human being carries an inner wholeness. That connection is the path back home.
final.headline: If your heart feels a quiet yes, we would be honoured to walk this journey with you.
final.body: Soulwayo is not a place to become someone else. It is a space to return — gently, honestly, and in your own timing.
